title: A quote request comes in
blurb: Somebody emails asking for a price on things you don't stock. What happens next.
asks: Somebody emails you asking for a price. Talk me through what happens after that.
sample:
From: purchasing@harrellmachine.example
Subject: RFQ - PO 4471

Please quote the following:

  Qty 24 ea  part # CB-1140-R
  Qty 6 each  model SLT/220

Need delivered by September 12. Ship to 4402 Industrial Blvd, Bldg C.
Call me at (901) 555-0188 with any questions. Budget is around $8,400.

Regards,
Marcus Feld

steps.name: Read the request and work out what they mean
steps.note: Half of them don't use your part numbers.

steps.name: Type the lines into the quote
Check what it costs us now
steps.note: This is the one that goes to three different places.

steps.name: Somebody prices it
steps.note: Margin call. Depends on the customer and how busy we are.

steps.name: Follow up on quotes nobody answered
